6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Increased the range in which Sartura's Dancing Blades can travel, and increased the time before their default movement selects a new position. In addition, we gave these blades a minimum range from the boss. This will create an effect where the blades will get closer to their desired position, and will also make it so blades, while they will often pass through the melee circle, wont ever stop inside of it, reducing physical damage dealt to melee players while not affected ranged players all that much.

2.author: Rushor(345123879272054786)
2.description:
Add scripts for several Engineering/Jewelcrafting pets

(1) Rough Stone Statue, Coarse Stone Statue, Heavy Stone Statue, Solid Stone Statue and Dense Stone Statue will now heal the player if he is out of combat.

(2) The Goblin Land Mine now has a arming time of 15 seconds and casts a detonation on hostile creatures.

(3) Goblin Bomb and  Explosive Sheep now attack hostile victims in 30 yards range, run close to it, explode and Despawn.

(4) Steam Tonk Controller and Battered Steam Tonk Controller can now be used to attack other Steam Tonks.

(5) Target Dummy, Advanced Target Dummy and Masterwork Target Dummy now generates threat to neearby hostile creatures. After the dummy died it can be looted.

(6) Compact Harvest Reaper now despawns after 10 minutes.

5.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
5.description:
The AQ 40 Warrior set has been reworked and is now: 
(3) Your Shout spells are enhanced: 

Battle Shout: Increases your critical strike rating by 28.

Demoralizing Shout: Generates 100% additional threat.

Intimidating Shout: Cooldown and rage cost reduced by 15%.

Challenging Shout: Reduces the damage the affected targets deal by 20%.
(5) Your Thunder Clap now deals an additional 30% damage (15% to players) as Nature.

5.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
5.description:
The AQ 40 Warlock set has been reworked and is now: 
(3) Increases your Shadow critical damage by 5% and your Fire critical damage by 2%.
(5) Your Shadowburn does 200% increased damage (100% to players) to targets below 30% health.

5.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
5.description:
The AQ 40 Shaman set has been reworked and is now: 
(3) Your Shaman Shields are enhanced:

Lighting Shield- Increases all Nature damage dealt by 2%.

Water Shield- Reduces the cast time of your Shaman healing spells by 3%.

Earth Shield- Increases all healing received by 2%.
(5) Your Riptide, Healing Wave, and Lesser Healing Wave critical heals reduce the cast time of your next 2 Chain Heals by 25%. Also, each time your Chain Lightning deals damage its cooldown is reduced by 1 sec and reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt by 0.1 sec.

5.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
5.description:
The AQ 40 Rogue set has been reworked and is now: 
(3) Using a Rogue finisher have a 10% chance to generate 5 combo points.
(5) You gain stacks of Stalking every 2 seconds. Stalking increases your melee attack power by 10 and increases the damage of your Rogue combo point generators by 1%, stacking up to 10 times. Upon reaching 10 stacks they reset.

5.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
5.description:
The AQ 40 Priest set has been reworked and is now: 
(3) 50% chance that your heals on other will also heal you 10% of the amount healed.
(5) You have a 25% chance when you cast Power Word: Shield, Renew, or Vampiric Touch to cast a second similar, but weaker effect on the target.

5.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
5.description:
The AQ 40 Paladin set has been reworked and is now: 
(3) Your auto attacks have a chance to trigger Divine Favor on you. This effect increases the critical strike chance of your next Paladin ability except seals and judgement by 50%.
(5) Your Crusader Strike and Divine Storm deals an additional 33% (11% to players) of your spell power as Holy damage.

5.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
5.description:
The AQ 40 Mage set has been reworked and is now: 
(3) The Clearcasting effect from your Arcane Concentration now also reduces the cast time of your next spell by 20%.
(5) Your Arcane Power, Combustion, and Icy Veins further empower your abilities:

Arcane Power: Your Arcane Missiles fires an additional time.

Combustion: Reduces the cast time of your Fireball by 20% while active and increases the charges by 2.

Icy Veins: Generates 2 stacks of Fingers of Frost when used and resets the cooldown of your Deep Freeze and increases its damage by 100%.

5.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
5.description:
The AQ 40 Druid set has been reworked and is now: 
(3) Your Omen of Clarity also increases the damage or healing of your next spell by 10%.
(5) Your Shapeshift forms are enhanced:

Moonkin: Your Force of Nature spell summons 2 additional Treants and your Starfall deals 50% more damage (20% to players).

Cat: Your critical strikes have a chance to reset the cooldown of your Tigers Fury.

Bear and Dire Bear: Your critical strikes increases the duration of your Barkskin by 1 second. This effect cannot occur more than once each second.

Tree of Life: Your Regrowth Heal over time effect and your Rejuvenation heals plant a Seed of Life in the target healing them each second for 4 seconds, stacking up to 8 times. Upon reaching 8 stacks the seed blooms and heals the target and nearby allies.

5.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
5.description:
The AQ 40 Hunter set has been reworked and is now: 
(3) You have an additional 4% chance to trigger your Wild Quiver talent.
(5) Your Chimera Shot has a 100% chance and your Mongoose Bite has a 50% chance to leave a lingering poisons on the target dealing Nature damage every 2 seconds for 14 seconds and stacking up to 3 times. Upon reaching 3 stacks the poison is expunged from the target, dealing Nature damage the target and nearby enemies.

5.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
5.description: Jom Gabbar now increases your attack power by 70 per stack.

5.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
5.description: The Burrower's Shell now increases your armor by 200 and your dodge rating by 16 and now absorbs 2000 damage.

5.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
5.description: Scarab Brooch now increases your Spirit by 22 and its effect now has a 20 second duration and a 2 min cooldown.

5.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
5.description: Fetish of the Sand Reaver has been reworked and now longer reduces your threat on use. It instead grants 37 spell power and has a chance to grant you 45 mp5 for 15 seconds after casting a spell.

5.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
5.description: Petrified Scarab now also increases your Stamina by 30.
